title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Berry Blast 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Berry Blast Nic Salt e-liquid serves up a delicious medley of ripe, juicy Berries, perfectly balanced for a rich and fruity all-day vape. The natural sweetness of the berries delivers a fresh and satisfying flavour profile, making it a must-try for fans of mixed berry blends. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. These e-liquids offer smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, providing a satisfying and enjoyable alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths, this flavour delivers a smooth and flavour-packed vape experience. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK vape brand known for their innovative and exciting e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range offers the vibrant taste of disposable vape flavours in a more versatile and reusable format. Be sure to explore other delicious options like Raspberry Pomegranate, Blackcurrant Menthol, and Lime Twist.
